run_worker_executor: run the WorkerExecutor to start a worker loop and web app with heartbeat monitoring
test_heartbeat: test the heartbeat method that sends periodic heartbeats for the current job in the queue
test_kill_zombies: test the kill_zombies method that detects and marks crashed jobs missing heartbeats
test_kill_long_job: test the kill_long_job method that terminates jobs exceeding the maximum allowed duration
test_ensure_webapp: test the ensure_webapp method that restarts the web app if it crashes
